recs.title: Communities
recs.lead: The communities you have permissions on.

denied.title: No community to administer
denied.body: You signed in successfully, but your account has no permissions on any community in this installation.
denied.hint: A REC administrator must add you to the community's Keycloak organization and to one of these groups:
denied.switch_account: Sign out and sign in with another account

queue.ref_hint: Only the reference is searchable: name, email, fiscal code and POD are encrypted.
queue.declared_pending: Says they are already a member: POD or address to complete from the register
queue.declared_complete: Says they are already a member: completed from the register

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: This community only. Most recent entries first.

exports.title: Exports
exports.forbidden: You do not have permission to export this community's data.
exports.csv_hint: The community's register, for its own use. It names no recipient and is not for giving data to another organisation.
exports.pods_hint: This community's own dated record for one offer: the supply points that stood authorised, and those whose members withdrew, each in its own column, at the moment it is generated. It is kept here and handed to nobody — nothing is recorded as a disclosure. A snapshot: a later decision is in the next export.

detail.name: Name
detail.phone_verification_waived: not verified — phone verification is disabled on this deployment, so approval does not require it
detail.supply_boundary_no_area: {{id}}, in no area of this community
detail.reveal_audited: Every unmasked view is recorded in the audit log.
detail.reveal_forbidden: Fiscal code and POD are masked: revealing them requires permission.
detail.enablement_hint: What approval produced. Blocking steps prevent approval until they succeed; the others can be retried later.
detail.revoke_confirm: Revoke enablement? The data-sharing consent and the dataspace credential will be withdrawn, the login disabled and the community membership deactivated.
detail.verification_hint: Before approving, record how the community verified that the participant is who they declare and holds the declared POD. Documents are not required here: a check done by the community outside the platform counts. The method is recorded in the participant's credential and registry entry.
detail.verification_none: No verification recorded. The application cannot be approved until one is.
detail.verification_offline: Checked by the community outside the platform
detail.verification_uploaded_document: Checked against a document uploaded here
detail.verification_needed_to_approve: Record how the participant was verified before approving.
detail.verification_offline_with_evidence: Checked by the community outside the platform, with the evidence file attached
detail.verification_evidence_why: This community shares its members' supply points (POD) with the grid operator. Each time it does, the community declares, on its own responsibility, that the member holds the POD, and names the evidence it checked. That is why a check done outside the platform counts here only with the evidence you checked attached, for example the bill or the identity document.
detail.verification_evidence_keep: The file is not stored on the platform. Only its fingerprint is kept: a code computed from the file, which later shows exactly which file was checked. Keep the file in the community's own records for the retention period agreed with the grid operator. The applicant is not asked for anything more.
detail.verification_evidence_file_hint: Attach the document you checked. It is read only to compute its fingerprint, and is then discarded.
detail.verification_uploaded_keep: Download this document and keep it in the community's records: the platform deletes uploaded documents once the member's account is active, and keeps only their fingerprint.
detail.verification_renew_hint: This member is already approved. Record a new verification with evidence only if the grid operator suspended one of their supply points (for example after a change of contract holder), or if the verification on record has no evidence. The grid operator releases the member's data again only on a verification newer than the suspension.
detail.verification_asserted: Declared to the grid operator on
detail.revisions_hint: From submission on, the POD, first name, last name, email, fiscal code and supply address are corrected here rather than edited. Each correction keeps the value it replaces, how the new one was checked and why. The oldest value of a field is what the person declared.
detail.revision_method: How was the new value checked?
detail.revision_note_placeholder: How you checked it, e.g. read from the bill with the member on the phone
detail.revision_propagates: This member is already approved: the correction is then carried to their account, the registry and the dataspace (for a POD: the registry, then every grant at a holder, with the new POD), step by step, shown under it. A failed step can be retried.
detail.existing_member: Says they are already a member.
detail.existing_member_pending: To complete from the member register before approval
detail.existing_member_complete: POD and supply address completed from the member register.
detail.existing_member_reject_hint: Not in the member register? You can also tell them with a prefilled email, to review before sending:

invitation.sent: Invitation to set a password sent.
invitation.has_password: The account already has a password: no invitation needed.
invitation.not_on_dev_list: Invitation not sent: this environment only emails the addresses on its recipient list.
invitation.account_disabled: Invitation not sent: the account is disabled.
invitation.not_requested: Not sent yet: it goes out when approval completes.
invitation.cooldown: Invitation not sent: this account was emailed moments ago, so a second one was not sent.
invitation.send_failed: Invitation not sent: the email could not be sent. Retry this step to try again.
invitation.no_email: Invitation not sent: the account has no email address, so no invitation can reach it.

shared_pods.title: Shared PODs
shared_pods.lead: Supply points (POD) that more than one active member holds, as the REC registry reports them. A POD is one grid connection, so one of the holders has the wrong one — usually a mistyped code. The registry refuses to give such a POD again until it is resolved.
shared_pods.guidance: For each one: check it with the member, then correct the wrong POD by revision on their application (Corrections panel).
shared_pods.none: No POD is held by more than one active member.
shared_pods.reveal_forbidden: PODs are masked; showing them needs the reveal permission.
shared_pods.failed: The list could not be read: {{message}}

areas.title: Areas in the registry
areas.lead: Whether the REC registry's areas match this community's template. The template is the source of truth; a platform admin pushes it with the registry sync.
areas.drift: The registry differs from the template. A platform admin can run the registry sync (onboarding-cli registry-sync) to bring it in line.
areas.not_synced: This community's areas are not primary-substation boundaries, so nothing of its template is synced to the registry.
areas.failed: The registry could not be read: {{message}}
